weeks.name: Week 1
weeks.description:
--- 3x DAY/WEEK FULL BODY STRENGTH & HYPERTROPHY PROGRAM ---
Each workout uses one working set per exercise taken close to failure (RPE 9–10), with a Power Warmup Set beforehand to prime the nervous system. The program runs in 4-week cycles where progression is simple: keep the same weight and add one rep per week (e.g., Week 1: 5 reps, Week 2: 6 reps, etc.). At the end of the cycle, re-test your 10RM and start the next cycle heavier.

programs.description:
Fun adaptation of GZCL: General Gainz program, with several variations of really interesting progression schemes available.

By default the program is set up with Classic progressions, but in the there're all possible progressions in the exercise library available. Just add/change an exercise, and specify "Reuse logic" to one of the progression schemes you wish.

Make sure to read the original post on Reddit describing the program before starting!
